mirrors: Cargo files that are not roots: a vendored dependency crate under vendor/ that .cargo/config.toml routes crates-io to (the application's build consumes it; it is dependency inventory, not a unit), and a stale Cargo.lock in a directory whose Cargo.toml is gone

not_units.reason: a crate under vendor/ with a .cargo-checksum.json is a vendored dependency the application's cargo build reads through the vendored-sources replacement; it is never dispatched on its own
a Cargo.lock without a Cargo.toml is a leftover lockfile; there is nothing to build
